description: This module installs, updates and removes packages from the OpenCSW project for Solaris.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: To allow the update process to downgrade packages to match what is present in the repository, set this to true. This is useful for rolling back to stable from testing, or similar operations. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the package. When using state=latest, this can be '*', which updates all installed packages managed by pkgutil.

parameters.name: site
parameters.description: The repository path to install the package from. Its global definition is in /etc/opt/csw/pkgutil.conf.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether to install (present/installed), or remove (absent/removed) packages. The upgrade (latest) operation updates/installs the packages to the latest version available. Choices: "absent" "installed" "latest" "present" "removed"

parameters.name: update_catalog
parameters.description: If you always want to refresh your catalog from the mirror, even when it is not stale, set this to true. Choices: false ← (default) true

examples:
- name: Install a package
  community.general.pkgutil:
    name: CSWcommon
    state: present

- name: Install a package from a specific repository
  community.general.pkgutil:
    name: CSWnrpe
    site: ftp://myinternal.repo/opencsw/kiel
    state: latest

- name: Remove a package
  community.general.pkgutil:
    name: CSWtop
    state: absent

- name: Install several packages
  community.general.pkgutil:
    name:
      - CSWsudo
      - CSWtop
    state: present

- name: Update all packages
  community.general.pkgutil:
    name: '*'
    state: latest

- name: Update all packages and force versions to match latest in catalog
  community.general.pkgutil:
    name: '*'
    state: latest
    force: true
